title: Underlying module inverse-image comparison compatible with the unit
statement: Let C,D be small sites in the same universe, F:C to D continuous and representably flat, and assume set-sheaf pullback along F preserves finite limits. Let A on C and B on D be ring sheaves, with structural map phi:A to F_*B [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose the underlying set sheaves of A,B carry a pullback-unit presentation p whose unit is the underlying map of phi [def-weil-pbc-sheaf-pullback-unit-presentation]. Let L be the chosen module pullback along phi, and U_A,U_B the forgetful functors to abelian sheaves. There exists a natural isomorphism e:L;U_B to U_A;F^-1_Ab such that, for every M, U_A(eta_module(M)) followed by F_*(e_M) equals eta_Ab(U_A(M)).

lean.statement:
theorem inverseImage_underlying_unit_of_ring_presentation
    [RepresentablyFlat F] [PreservesFiniteLimits (sheafPullback F (Type u) J K)]
    (pr : SheafPullbackUnitPresentation (F := F)
      ((sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget RingCat.{u})).obj A)
      ((sheafCompose K (CategoryTheory.forget RingCat.{u})).obj B))
    (hr : pr.unit = (sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget RingCat.{u})).map φ) :
    ∃ e : pullback.{u} φ ⋙ toSheaf B ≅
      toSheaf A ⋙ sheafPullback F AddCommGrpCat.{u} J K,
      ∀ M, (toSheaf A).map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction φ).unit.app M) ≫
        (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} J K).map (e.hom.app M) =
        (sheafAdjunctionContinuous F AddCommGrpCat.{u} J K).unit.app
          ((toSheaf A).obj M)
